validation.variables: Keep the variables exactly as in the original, e.g. {product_name}

settings.title: AI settings
settings.description: Google Gemini credentials for product content generation and for translating language strings.
settings.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted; shown masked. Leave the mask to keep the current key.

content.title: Content generation (Gemini)
content.description: Writes product names, descriptions, SEO tags and settings for admins and sellers.
content.sellerLimitHint: Tokens each seller may use per month; admins are not limited. Saving applies the limit to every seller.

translate.title: AI translation
translate.description: Fills empty language strings with Gemini. Uses its own key, separate from content generation.
translate.apiKeyHint: Used only for translating language strings. Keep it private.

prompts.title: Prompt templates
prompts.description: Instructions sent to Gemini. Edit the wording, but keep every {variable} exactly as it is.

usage.title: Token usage
usage.description: Requests and tokens spent by AI features, by user and model.
usage.empty: No AI usage found for this period.

translate.title: AI translation
translate.description: Fills the empty strings of a language, 50 keys per request. Text that already exists is never overwritten.

engineHint.ai: Needs AI translation enabled and its API key (AI settings).
engineHint.google: Free machine translation; no key needed.

result.failed: The request failed; {{count}} strings were translated before it. Run again to continue.
result.disabled: AI translation is switched off. Enable it in AI settings.
result.no_key: No Gemini API key for translation. Add it in AI settings.
